decisions.reason: As a prominently promoted extension of the firm's core candle-arch craft, it fits the brand well and is likely to stay in the range.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's established seasonal wooden décor business and was important enough to feature on the home page.
Although more distant from the traditional assortment, it was presented as a flagship direction and would likely be given more time to establish itself.
As a less prominently presented accessory tied to a newer and less proven product concept, it is the most likely item to be rationalized out of the assortment.
Despite being an accessory to the newer music-box concept, its Christmas theme matches the firm's strongest seasonal customer demand well enough to retain it for now.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional strengths and was clearly marketed as a visible part of the assortment.
